title: Action execution output
description: One chunk of a running action's output, persisted and published under the create routing key on the execution output exchange.

execution-id.description: The run this chunk belongs to. Wire key: execution_id.

action-ref.description: Reference of the action being run, in pack.name form. Wire key: action_ref.

runner-ref.description: Which runner produced it. Wire key: runner_ref.

output-type.description: Which stream the characters came from — standard output and standard error are recorded separately. Wire key: output_type.

data.description: The chunk itself. No offset and no sequence number; order is write order.

timestamp.description: When the chunk was recorded — the only ordering this shape carries.

delay.description: Pacing hint for a consumer when output arrives faster than it can be forwarded. Not a duration of anything.
